As Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) Stock Rose, Holder Sheets Smith Wealth Management Lifted Position
May 20, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Sheets Smith Wealth Management increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 455.17% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sheets Smith Wealth Management bought 23,432 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 28,580 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.93M, up from 5,148 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sheets Smith Wealth Management who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $501.05B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.52% or $1.02 during the last trading session, reaching $195. About 14.24 million shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since May 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
